records.summary: Added fresh Base cbXRP DEX activity: DexTrading's 00:28 UTC page shows $1.25 price, $189.98M market cap, $3.57M 24h volume, $485K main Aero cbXRP/WETH liquidity and 4,965 trades (2,477 buys / 2,488 sells). Volume/liquidity is about 7.36x, but the near-balanced trade counts and lack of notional flow prevent a net-capital inference. Identified stale/inconsistent third-party cbXRP supply data: CoinDesk page shows 107.04M, Trading Strategy body 60.95M while its search snippet shows 151.403M. These are excluded; Coinbase's first-party 151.403M supply / 151.405M XRP reserve page remains the best published baseline pending independent Base totalSupply() verification. No forecast or market feature admitted.
actions: Captured DexTrading Base cbXRP pools at 00:28 UTC and recorded main-pool liquidity, 24-hour volume, trades and visible pair list.
Calculated 24-hour turnover relative to main-pool liquidity at 7.36x; explicitly did not classify as net inflow.
Compared CoinDesk and Trading Strategy cbXRP supply pages with Coinbase's first-party reserve/supply page; marked stale/inconsistent values as excluded.
Updated the feature gate: pool-level events, notional buy/sell amounts, mint/burn and independent Base totalSupply() required before cbXRP market features can enter a model.
blockers: DexTrading is a single third-party aggregator; pool volume/liquidity and buy/sell counts are not independent chain-derived net capital.
CoinDesk and Trading Strategy cbXRP supply pages are stale/inconsistent.
Independent Base totalSupply() verification remains unavailable; Coinbase's page is first-party, not an independent audit.
next_actions: Verify Base totalSupply() via accessible RPC and reconcile against Coinbase PoR page at a common block/time.
